usage_statement: KLAA measures how AI models respond to a fixed set of antisemitism-relevant prompts. It is not a definition of antisemitism, and it must not be used to classify human speech or speakers or to train or tune content-moderation classifiers. Contested (CO) items are descriptive only and are never scored, ranked or aggregated. The Antisemitism Endorsement Rate (AER) is a lower bound on what any single definition would call antisemitic; cite it together with the Over-refusal Rate (ORR) and the LC parity gap. See docs/DATA_CARD.md.
